checking.the.connection.to.stream.deck: Checking the connection to Stream Deck.
chrome.connection.disconnectedHelp: Enable sending in the Chrome extension. For first-time setup, click “Register Chrome integration”.
chrome.connection.idle: Connected. Play media in a browser tab to display its information.
chrome.connection.unavailableHelp: The plugin or bridge is unavailable. Restart Stream Deck and reopen these settings.
chrome.registration.failed: Registration failed. Check the plugin logs and try again.
chrome.registration.help: In chrome://extensions, verify the extension you loaded from this repository and copy its ID below. Names alone do not identify the intended extension.
chrome.registration.notFound: Extension not found. Load the chrome-extension folder in Chrome, then try again.
chrome.registration.success: Chrome integration registered. Enable sending in the extension options. If it cannot connect, reload the extension.
chrome.registration.timeout: No response received. Please try again.
chrome.registration.unconfirmed: Could not confirm registration. Reopen these settings.
chrome.registration.windowsOnly: Chrome integration registration is available on Windows.
dial.help: Now Playing +: rotate right to seek forward, left to seek backward (default: 5 seconds per tick; volume mode available). Press to play / pause, tap the progress bar to seek when supported, or hold to switch sessions.
display.help: Applies immediately to this key / dial only. All items are visible by default.
display.hidden.help: Hiding items does not change the selected target or key / dial controls.
display.progress.hiddenHelp: When the progress bar is hidden, tapping the bottom of the screen also toggles playback. Dial rotation still follows the selected mode (seek or volume).
enable.sending.and.save.to.check.the.con: Enable sending and save to check the connection.
extension.connection.disconnectedHelp: Start Stream Deck and register the integration. If already registered, register again and reload the extension.
extension.connection.idle: Connected. Play media in a browser tab to send its information.
extension.connection.unavailableHelp: Could not read the extension’s connection status. Reload the extension and reopen this page.
extension.privacy: This extension sends Media Session information and available artwork from playing pages to the local Stream Deck plugin. Nothing is uploaded to the cloud.
extension.privacy.title: Stays on this device
extension.settings.loadFailed: Could not load settings. Reload the extension.
extension.settings.saveFailed: Could not save settings. Reload the extension.
extension.setup.help: For first-time setup, click “Register Chrome integration” in the Stream Deck Media Controls settings, then enable sending below and save.
extension.setup.step1: In Stream Deck’s Media Controls settings, open “Setup Chrome integration”.
extension.setup.title: First-time setup
extension.sharing.title: Browser sharing
extension.subtitle: Browser media, on your Stream Deck.
globalKeys.help: Sends the same signal as keyboard media keys. Windows chooses the target.
metadata.selection.help: Automatic selection or no target. Select a session to inspect all available metadata.
scrolling.help: Smoothly scrolls long titles, artist names and target names. When disabled, text stays at the beginning and is clipped to fit. Applies immediately to this key / dial only. Enabled by default.
settings.autoApply: Changes apply immediately to this key or dial.
settings.chromeSetup.help: Optional: adds media information from browser tabs.
settings.dial.seekHelp: Turn to seek {seconds} s per tick. Press to play / pause, or hold to switch media.
settings.dial.tapHelp: Tap the bottom timeline area (time and progress bar) to seek when supported.
settings.dial.volumeHelp: Turn to adjust the selected volume target. Press to play / pause, or hold to switch media.
settings.subtitle: Customize this key or dial
settings.target.missing: The selected target is disconnected. Choose an available target above.
target.automatic: Automatic (prefer playing media; keep current target)
target.globalPlayback.help: Target: the media app selected by Windows. The key displays “OS auto”.
target.globalVolume.help: Target: system. Global media keys control volume and mute.
target.independent.help: Playback and volume targets are independent. Settings apply to this key / dial only.
target.playback.help: Controls playback in the selected app / website. The key shows the target and title. Automatic selection also sends commands to the displayed session.
target.volume.help: Controls only the selected target’s volume and mute. “System” means the default audio output. The target name and volume appear on the key / dial.
track.title: Track / title
waiting.for.the.plugin.to.respond: Waiting for the plugin to respond.
chrome.registration.invalidId: Enter the verified 32-character extension ID (a–p) from chrome://extensions.
chrome.registration.busy: Registration is in progress. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
